run_silk_cli_training: run the silk CLI with mode=train-magicpoint to start training the configured model
run_silk_cli_benchmark: run the silk CLI with mode=benchmark-magicpoint to start benchmarking the configured model
run_silk_cli_override_gpus: run the silk CLI with mode=train-magicpoint overriding gpus to [0,1] and disabling output print
run_silk_cli_command: run the silk CLI dispatching to a command from training, inference, benchmark, check, cache_dataset, visualization, hpatches_tests, viewreid_tests, or image_pair_visualization
run_silk_cli_formatter: run the silk CLI with a custom formatter instantiated via hydra to format command output
